qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the injection nozzle combination assembly (1AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The torque specification for the injection nozzle combination assembly (1AZ) is 80 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What screw type is used for the injection nozzle combination to cylinder head (2AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The screw type used for the injection nozzle combination to cylinder head (2AZ) is M21.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque value for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination (3AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The torque value for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination (3AZ) is 20 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two screw types used for the injection nozzle combination assembly (1AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The two screw types used for the injection nozzle combination assembly (1AZ) are M21/M51.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the M51/M41 screw in the injection nozzle combination to cylinder head connection?
qa_pairs.answer: The torque specification for the M51/M41 screw in the injection nozzle combination to cylinder head connection is 65 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Which component uses M43/M44 screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: The feed line on injection panel (4AZ) uses M43/M44 screw type.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this page cover?
qa_pairs.answer: This page covers section 13-6, Fuel metering and regulation system, specifically 13 53 Fuel Injection Nozzles and Pipes.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque value for the feed line on injection panel (4AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The torque value for the feed line on injection panel (4AZ) is 20 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: How many different components are listed in the Fuel Injection Nozzles and Pipes section?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 4 different components listed in the Fuel Injection Nozzles and Pipes section, labeled 1AZ through 4AZ.

qa_pairs.question: What screw types are used for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination (3AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: The screw types used for the injection pipe coupling nut to injection pump and nozzle combination (3AZ) are M21/M51/M41.
